parole.significato: A type of waffle from Romandy (francophone Switzerland).
A racing sled for one or two people that is ridden with the rider or riders lying on their back.
parole.testo: The noun is borrowed from Swiss French or Franco-Provençal luge, from Medieval Latin scludia, from Late Latin sclodia, of Celtic origin, from Gaulish *stludio, possibly from Proto-Indo-European *h₃sleydʰ- (“to slide, slip; to be slick or slippery”). If so, it is related to sled and sleigh. Sense 2.2

parole.significato: Any of numerous traditional Swiss melodies played on the alpenhorn, originally to call cows in from the mountains.
parole.testo: From Swiss French ranz des vaches.
